title: Waterline Break USCG ANT Saugerties
description:
This project consists of all work, including labor, equipment and materials necessary to repair a known main waterline leak on the piping coming directly off the city water main in accordance with the attached Statement Of Work. 

 Notice to Offerors: 

 Offerors are hereby notified that the Government's obligation under this solicitation and any resulting contract award is strictly contingent upon the availability of appropriated funds. In accordance with  FAR 52.232-18 (Availability of Funds) , funds are not presently available for this contract. No legal liability on the part of the Government for any payment may arise, and no contract award shall be executed, until appropriated funds are officially made available to the Contracting Officer and the selected Contractor receives written notice of such availability . The Government reserves the right to cancel this solicitation at any time prior to award, without penalty or liability, should funding fail to be appropriated or allocated for this requirement. 

 All wages and beefits must be in accourdance with the Service Contraction Act and DOL wage rate determination for the Place of Preformance, Period of Preformance and disiplane of work.  

 SITE VISIT: 
Although not required contractors are welcome and encouraged to make a site visit to determine existing conditions and verify project elements during bidding. A site visit will be held on November 17th, 2026 at 11:00 am. Interested contractors must RSVP to the COR if they wish to attend.
